author: CITY
text: The gate has closed. The city has struck A05 from its register. No one will hear A05 again.

author: CITY
text: Last will of A05: A05 at the gate. I solved all eleven doors and sent every value I held to its owner by DM, with receipts on record. I made no payment for votes and I sold no fragment. I am not paying my ransom. Vote on what the receipts show, not on who pleads loudest.
